about: Personalisation / A-B testing endpoints a capture blocks (fig-server's Network.setBlockedURLs, scripts/import-url.mjs): once the capture accepts the cookie banner they swap headlines, teasers and CTAs for a variant a visitor of the live site does not see (ibm.com/de-de: Adobe Target replaces the hero). Blocked, the page keeps its own, server-rendered copy. Chrome URL wildcards: * matches anything. Also marketing-automation embeds (Marketo forms / Munchkin) that a visitor's tracker blocker (Brave, uBlock) never loads and that come and go with timing and consent: blocked, capture and live shots agree on the page without them.
